// diagnostic E0607

Jet.ModuleFileNotFound

`name: module;` file declaration not found

What

`name: module;` file declaration not found

Why

A module declaration names a file next to this one, and no such file exists

Fix

Add the matching `name: module;` file declaration.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ModuleFileNotFound: Tests/UI/ModuleMissing/stderr.

Error: Jet.ModuleFileNotFound: Module `missing` not found
  --> Tests/UI/ModuleMissing/run.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | missing: module
    | ^^^^^^^
 Why: Looked for `missing.jet` and `missing/module.jet` next to this file
 Fix: Create `missing.jet` next to this file
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.ModuleFileNotFound
